checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Both hands and entire blue sheet visible on wooden table
must.why: Paper is white, not blue; sheet partly cropped at frame edge.

must.item: Hands bring one half over the other, producing a fold
must.why: Left hand lifts and folds the paper over progressively.

must.item: Hands press along the crease after folding
must.why: Final frame shows pinching/smoothing near the fold but no clear pressing along the crease.

must.item: Hands anatomically plausible with convincing contact
must.why: Hands look mostly natural, minor blur in frame 3.

must.item: Paper remains a single consistent object
must.why: White sheet stays consistent, though shape shifts slightly.

must.item: Eight-second widescreen, fixed overhead shot, no sound
must.why: 5 s clip, low-angle side view with slight camera drift, not overhead.

faults.what: Paper is white instead of the required blue sheet.
Camera is a side/low angle, not a fixed overhead shot; duration is 5 s not 8 s.
Paper geometry changes ambiguously between frames; no clear crease press.

summary: A realistic 5-second clip of hands folding white paper on a wooden table, but it misses the blue paper, overhead fixed shot, 8-second length and crease press.
